blogPosts.title: Bridal Prep: Skincare Secrets for a Flawless Foundation
blogPosts.content: Every bride wants their makeup to look flawless and last all day. The secret isn't just in the foundation—it's in the skin preparation. Learn how to optimize your skin barrier in the 4 weeks leading up to your wedding to ensure Pat McGrath or NARS pigments sit beautifully and absorb seamlessly under high-flash studio cameras.

blogPosts.title: Designing the Perfect Screen Look: HD Camera Matching
blogPosts.content: Makeup for film and television requires a completely different approach than bridal or everyday glam. With 8K digital cameras capturing every pore, the technique must focus on high-definition matte layering, color-correction gradients, and sweat-proofing. Here, we outline the exact on-set touch-up routines we use for lead actors to guarantee screen continuity.

blogPosts.title: Skincare Prep for Melanin-Rich Skin: What Actually Works
blogPosts.content: Melanin-rich skin has unique needs when it comes to makeup preparation. Hyperpigmentation, uneven texture, and ashiness are common concerns that the right prep routine can address. In this guide, we break down the essential steps — from gentle exfoliation with lactic acid to the best hydrating primers for dark skin tones — that ensure your makeup sits flawlessly and lasts all day.

blogPosts.title: How to Prep for Your Bridal Makeup Trial
blogPosts.content: Your bridal makeup trial is one of the most important appointments before the big day. Come with clean, moisturized skin, bring inspiration photos of Black brides with similar features, and don"t be afraid to speak up about what you love or want to change. We walk you through exactly what to expect during a luxury bridal trial and how to get the most out of your session with Joann.

blogPosts.title: The Best Makeup Products for Dark Skin Tones in 2026
blogPosts.content: Finding the right foundation shade, the perfect nude lip, or a bronzer that doesn"t look ashy can be a challenge. We"ve curated a list of our go-to products for deep skin tones — from Pat McGrath"s foundation range to Fenty"s contour sticks and NARS" blushes that pop beautifully on melanin-rich complexions. These are the products Joann reaches for on every shoot.
